checks.name: EN exemption applies to course based on placement
checks.detail: Not necessarily. The guide notes that credit transfer, substitute courses or placement-based course exemptions may not yet be matched. Take approval and grade records to your department or registration office. Do not duplicate courses yourself; discontinued required courses need the offering unit’s designated substitute.

checks.name: JA exemption applies to course based on level determination
checks.detail: 必ずしもそうではありません。単位認定・代替科目・習熟度判定に基づく履修免除が未対応の場合があります。承認書と成績を持って学科か教務窓口に相談し、自己判断で重複履修しないでください。廃止された必修は開講単位指定の代替科目で対応します。

checks.name: EN return procedure and submissions both retained
checks.detail: After acceptance, check the host, dates, grant and personal costs in your agreement, along with medical and accident insurance and a visa that permits the internship. Confirm pre-departure guidance and emergency contacts. Remain enrolled during the internship and report back to the university and submit the required outcomes afterward, as specified by the project.

checks.name: JA return procedure and submissions both retained
checks.detail: 採用後は契約の受入先・期間・補助・自己負担額、医療・傷害保険と実習を認める査証を確認します。出発前に説明会と緊急連絡先を確認し、実習中は学籍を維持してください。終了後は計画に従って帰校手続きと成果提出を行います。
